answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose shares authorize rate-limited messages under a Semaphore identity commitment. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a nullifier; repeating a nullifier in the same epoch exposes enough Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key, proving duplicate messaging without revealing it beforehand. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral, making Sybil identities costly rather than a pearl hidden in a glacier or a knoll beyond detection.
